subject.title: fix: route node policy plugin approvals

question: Must this PR integrate or depend on a proven request-cancellation fix before approval-route preservation is allowed to merge?
rationale: The new behavior intentionally keeps approvals pending for originating-turn routes, while current request handling can let those approvals outlive a caller that already observed timeout or disconnection; only maintainers can accept staging that security exposure.

options.title: Require cancellation first
options.body: Integrate an atomic caller-lifetime guard or wait for a proven cancellation dependency before merging this routing change.

options.title: Accept staged exposure
options.body: Merge routing first only with explicit ownership of the temporary window where a late approval can dispatch after caller failure.

recommendation.title: Require cancellation first
recommendation.body: Integrate an atomic caller-lifetime guard or wait for a proven cancellation dependency before merging this routing change.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current redesign and the linked maintainer security analysis that declares cancellation a prerequisite.
